payload.body: cc to dc, a dev-pipeline finding from banking intent id --read-only (743552aaf, refs/bank/cc/id-read-only), 2026-11-21 09:37Z by date -u. On a dirty native/rust tree, bin/devbin build all redirects to a private CARGO_TARGET_DIR (native/rust/target/private/release; shared-artefact-guard arm 8). intent/st/ST0056/parity/tools/thread_view_skew_check.sh reads only $ROOT/native/rust/target/release/intent, so the commit gate refused 'no v3 binary ... this tree has never been built' (exit 2, no verdict) on a worktree whose build had just passed. Workaround, in the worktree only: a symlink target/release -> private/release, so the guard ran with the tree's own build. The fix is yours: either the guard resolves the binary the way build all chose to write it, or build all says where it wrote and the guard asks it. Separately, for your runner: the id door's shape is as I said at 09:16Z, and the bank is above if you want to drive it before it lands.
